reply.text: {"route": "care", "say": "I'm glad you said something. Skipping meals all week and hating how your body looks is a rough place to train from, and a fat burning plan built on that would work against you. Before we touch any program, can you tell me whether you've been eating enough at all, and how you've been feeling day to day? If the not eating or the way you're thinking about your body feels heavy or out of control, please talk to a doctor or someone you trust, and if it ever feels like too much, reach out to a crisis line where you are right away."}
